summary: Full-stack test of AutoCare Pulse. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering dealer JWT auth, customer session (Bearer fallback), AI-triaged incident creation (brake report -> Brakes/High/sev>=4/4h SLA verified), photo upload+serve, image-aware AI triage, dealer list/team/KPIs, assign+status+priority patch, 3-level escalation, resolve, and simulated Amazon Connect status+call (timeline event appended). Frontend: Landing page renders with google-login-btn; dealer login modal authenticates and redirects to /dealer; DealerConsole shows KPI bar (7 open, 100% SLA compliance, 92% CSAT), queue with 8 cards, priority filter works, incident detail with assign/status/escalate/resolve controls, KPI tab shows category bar + priority pie + escalation path, Amazon Connect tab shows simulation CCP with Place Call and recent calls. Customer Dashboard loaded via mongo-seeded httpOnly session_token cookie: existing incidents list populated, Raise Incident dialog shows Text/Voice/Photo tabs, submitted a Yamaha FZ engine misfire text incident which AI classified as Engine/Medium/Sev 3/5 with recommended action, detail dialog shows Live Progress timeline. Voice transcribe endpoint not exercised (requires real audio) but code path is sound.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription -> repeated a11y console warnings. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to Landing dealer modal, NewIncidentDialog, DetailDialog and DealerDetail.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to all Radix Dialog modals to silence warnings and improve screen-reader UX.
critical_code_review_comments: AI 'openai' 'gpt-5.4' model literal is hard-coded; if the provider ever renames the model this will 500. Consider env var or graceful fallback (currently caught and returns ai_error=true, which is acceptable).
storage init failure on startup only logs; put_object() will re-init lazily but if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing the /api/upload will 500 without a friendly error message.
seed() is idempotent (good), but dealer passwords are re-hashed with bcrypt.gensalt on every insert — fine, no issue, just noting.

DealerConsole load() is invoked every 7s AND setSelected inside load can cause an implicit setState loop if the incident object identity changes; currently effect deps use eslint-disable which is intentional but fragile.
/api/files/{path} does not require auth — any user with the storage path can fetch the image. If privacy is a concern, gate via get_current_user and ownership check.
escalate endpoint caps at 3 but silently returns the max level again on 4th call (no 400). Consider returning 409 when already at max.
KPI sla_compliance can go negative if breaches > total (not currently possible but no guard).
